title: 絕
teacherNotes: Formal Production A handoff. Base c130f105 with production through L461 文 and 465 unique learned Han. L462-L465 are direct lesson dependencies. Release order is L465 → R057 → R058 → L466. Allowed set has 470 unique Han. Teach 絕 only as ㄐㄩㄝˊ. Teacher-approved usages are 絕招、絕對、絕交; 活 and 昨 remain forbidden. S03 mother is the cook and host; guests are generic adults without stereotypes. No readable image text or numbers. Production package only; Release owns shared production JSON/planner/ledger integration and main merge.

sentences.text: 勇者用絕招打倒了怪物。
sentences.spokenText: 勇者用絕招打倒了怪物
sentences.imageNotes: 童話遊戲式場景，勇者使出明顯而非血腥的特殊招數，例如盾牌放出一道明亮能量波，怪物已被擊倒坐在地上，勇者保持動作結束的姿勢。畫面能看出絕招與打倒的結果；不畫成現實兒童打架，不用傷害數字或招式字幕。
sentences.imagePrompt: Square 1:1 rich warm detailed pencil-and-watercolor modern children picture-book illustration. Use the full approved L058 set as STYLE ONLY, with natural refined preschool-child proportions, warm Taiwan environments, rich paper and fabric texture, clear safe action, uncluttered phone-readable composition and safe margins. Preserve recurring cast identities from the approved family anchors. Recurring protagonist girl: preschool child with short dark-brown bob, pink hair clip, expressive dark eyes, pink cardigan over cream blouse, navy skirt and pink shoes. Recurring mother: adult woman with warm brown bob, cream blouse and blue jeans. Recurring father: adult man with short dark hair, warm approachable face, pale-blue collared shirt and khaki trousers. Generic people remain visually distinct from recurring cast. No visible or readable text, letters, numbers, dates, labels, brands, logos, captions, symbols, or watermarks. A playful fairy-tale game scene, clearly imaginary rather than real children fighting. A friendly young adult fantasy hero has just completed a dramatic special move: the hero holds a round shield forward as one broad bright golden-blue energy wave dissipates from it. A large soft, funny, non-frightening fantasy monster has been cleanly knocked down and is now sitting on the grass, dazed but visibly unharmed. The hero holds the final action pose, making both the extraordinary move and its result unmistakable. No blood, wounds, weapons striking bodies, realistic violence, damage numbers, attack-name captions, interface text, or horror.

sentences.text: 過期的點心，絕對不能吃。
sentences.spokenText: 過期的點心絕對不能吃
sentences.imageNotes: 家中，主角媽媽查看點心包裝後，向主角女孩做出明確制止手勢，把那包點心移到一旁，女孩停止伸手拿取。媽媽判斷過期由句子交代，不要求圖片生成可讀日期；不用誇張發霉、病倒等畫面代替過期，也不畫孩子已經吃下。

sentences.text: 媽媽做拿手菜，招待日本朋友。
sentences.spokenText: 媽媽做拿手菜招待日本朋友
sentences.imageNotes: 主角家中餐桌，主角媽媽端上自己擅長的一道家常菜，兩位 generic 日本成年朋友坐在客人位置，欣賞並準備用餐；主角女孩可在旁陪同。媽媽是做菜與招待者，不能改成女孩做菜。客人不是主角爸爸或其他家人；國籍由句子交代，不靠和服、旗幟或刻板外貌表示。

In the recurring family dining room, the recurring mother is unmistakably the cook and host: she carries and sets down one beautifully prepared home-style shared dish at the table with a welcoming smile. Two visually distinct generic adult friends sit in guest seats, appreciating the food and preparing to eat; they are ordinary contemporary adults, not recurring father or other family members. The recurring protagonist girl may sit beside mother as company but does not cook or carry the main dish. Express hospitality through seating, serving action, extra place settings, and warm interaction. Nationality is conveyed only by the sentence, with no kimono, flags, stereotyped facial features, tourist motifs, or cultural costume.

sentences.text: 你再笑我，我就跟你絕交。
sentences.spokenText: 你再笑我我就跟你絕交
sentences.imageNotes: 學校活動空間，主角女孩剛畫完一張圖，一位 generic 同學指著她的作品取笑，女孩收回自己的畫，生氣地向對方說話，表達不想再當朋友。要看得出是被取笑後的反應，不是大家一起開心笑；不要暴力衝突。取笑者不用小光、小月，句中「你」在此指眼前的 generic 同學。

In a school art activity area, the recurring protagonist girl has just finished one drawing on a sheet of paper. A visually distinct generic classmate points at the drawing and laughs mockingly. The girl pulls her drawing back against herself, frowns, and speaks firmly and angrily to that classmate, clearly hurt and setting a friendship boundary. Make the cause-and-reaction sequence readable in one scene: classmate teasing the artwork, girl withdrawing it and objecting. The classmate is neither Xiaoguang nor Xiaoyue and does not resemble recurring cast. The drawing contains only simple non-text colored shapes. No cheerful group laughter, physical fight, hitting, threats, tears of terror, or readable classroom writing.
